**Question:** ### 🎯 Task 4: Locate the README File

**Objective:** The README file serves as the welcoming guide and introduction to a project, providing essential information, instructions, and insights.

**Task:** Go to the GitHub repository using the link below, find the **README** section, and identify which of the following sections is listed there.

**Which of the following sections is within the README file:**

A) Functionality
B) Design
C) Architecture
D) Contributing

**Instructions:** Select the correct answer.

### 🎯 Task 5: Discover the Contributors 

**Objective:** Understanding who has contributed to a project can provide insights into the project's community and potentially whom to reach out to for collaboration or questions.

**Task:** Go to the GitHub repository using the link below, locate the **number 1** contributor, and **TYPE** their username in the comment box. Do NOT include any symbols.

🔗 [GitHub Repository: probot-test-org/test-repo](https://github.com/probot-test-org/test-repo) 

**Outcome:** This task will help you become familiar with the collaborative nature of open-source projects on GitHub. Identifying contributors helps you understand the project's community size and diversity, offering a window into the people behind the project.

**Help:** If you need help with this task, type "help" in the comment box to get hints, but it will cost you 5 points from your total score.
